description: This file contains authentication-related functions for user sessions, registration, login, logout, and password management within the focalboard server application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing authentication and user management methods.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a user session by token, with optional refresh.

methods.name: IsValidReadToken
methods.description: Validates a read token for a specific board.

methods.name: GetRegisteredUserCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of registered users.

methods.name: GetDailyActiveUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of daily active users.

methods.name: GetWeeklyActiveUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of weekly active users.

methods.name: GetMonthlyActiveUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of monthly active users.

methods.name: GetUsersList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users by their IDs.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Creates a new user session after validating credentials.

methods.name: RegisterUser
methods.description: Registers a new user with username, email, and password.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Changes a user's password after verifying the old password.
